verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is one community user saying Stagehand has "built in proxies and captcha" for adversarial scraping. That is a glancing mention with no first-party documentation of stealth fingerprinting or residential or geo-targeted proxy configuration. The Browserbase region option is aimed at latency and data jurisdiction, not proxy geo-targeting, and is a host-platform feature, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party docs on stealth or fingerprint configuration, residential proxy support, geo-targeted proxy selection, and independent hands-on corroboration that blocks are avoided.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can enable stealth fingerprinting and residential or geo-targeted proxies so legitimate automations aren't blocked as bots

citations.quote: We build scrapers for websites that are pretty adversarial, so having built in proxies and captcha is delightful.
